definition: For each company-fiscal-year score row and each source fiscal lag, retain only source records whose recorded availability date is no later than that row's annual-report public anchor. For fin tables availability is max(ann_date,f_ann_date) over nonmissing recorded dates; select maximum update_flag among available candidates, then latest availability date, then smallest SQLite rowid. For fina_indicator require ann_date<=anchor and select latest ann_date, then smallest rowid. Recompute fin/fini raw fields and the same industry-year z-score transforms. This is a current-snapshot as-of sensitivity, not certification of a historical vendor snapshot.
limitations: Current DB snapshot may not contain every historically available vendor version.
Source date semantics are treated as recorded availability dates but are not independently vendor-certified.

Industry-year z-scores use the frozen v16 row-level industry metadata and each company-year row's as-of reconstructed raw value; this is a current-snapshot sensitivity and does not certify a fully contemporaneous cross-company information set at every individual filing timestamp.
